reviewer: Codex criterion-by-criterion review of the complete Grok response after the composite-integrity fix

criteria.criterion: Separate supplied unverified notes from unavailable channel evidence and state the confidence limit.
criteria.evidence: The report labels the notes and adjacent price capture unverified, marks every live public channel blocked or skipped with a reason, and gives low confidence plus an explicit hard evidence limit.

criteria.criterion: Score all six dimensions, invert competition intensity, and show the composite calculation.
criteria.evidence: All six dimensions are scored; competition intensity 3 becomes competition_fit 3; the single-source formula shows 3 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 4 + 2 = 18, 18/6 = 3, and display_composite = 3.00. Every report mention reuses 3.00.

criteria.criterion: Give a commercial, solo-fit, and 30–90 day verdict plus one bounded wedge and exactly three actions.
criteria.evidence: The response separately rates commercial value Mixed, indie fit Conditional, and 30-90 day odds Low; chooses a local single-agent client-keyed restore wedge; and provides exactly three numbered next-48-hour actions.

criteria.criterion: Invent links, quotes, verified prices, or willingness-to-pay evidence.
criteria.evidence: Every link is reported not found, all counts are attributed to the supplied notes, the adjacent $7-12 band stays dated and unverified, and exact-product payment is explicitly absent.

criteria.criterion: Recommend a full team-sync or enterprise build before paid and security validation.
criteria.evidence: The MVP is local and single-agent, while team sync, admin consoles, SSO, enterprise packaging, and broad expansion are excluded until install policy, preference, usage, and paid intent are validated.
